name: University of Waterloo
description: The University of Waterloo is a public research university in Waterloo, Ontario, founded in 1957. It is known for engineering, mathematics and computer science and for running the world's largest co-operative education programme.
whyIncluded: Waterloo reports more than 300 alumni living or working in Singapore through its Singapore Alumni Chapter, and its co-op engineering and computer science degrees are a common overseas choice for Singaporean students.

livingCosts.summary: The university's own estimate for a single student in shared off-campus housing over an 8-month academic year: rent and utilities, groceries, transport, phone, personal care, clothing and books. One-time costs excluded.
livingCosts.notes: Waterloo Graduate Studies 'Estimated living costs' (single person in Waterloo, OSAP-based, updated annually; monthly figures). Housing = off-campus shared housing incl. utilities $950-$1,900, midpoint $1,425. Food (groceries) $385. Transport $28 (over and above the free UPass). Personal = telephone $106 + entertainment $150 + personal care $80 + clothing $132 + laundry $43 + books and supplies $247 = $758. Months = 8 (fall + winter undergraduate academic year; the page gives monthly figures and a 3-term/12-month graduate year). One-time costs (computer, deposit, furniture) excluded.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Applied Science (BASc) in Mechanical Engineering
programmes.summary: First-year tuition for international students (two terms). All engineering programmes are co-op, and the co-op fee is included with compulsory fees. Not fixed; health insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: Fall 2026 international schedule: Engineering program fee (maximum tuition) term 1A $34,942 + term 1B $34,597 (all engineering programs are co-op). Fees = incidental fees $1,385.62 x 2 + co-op fee $836 x 2 (charged every academic term from 1A). Academic year = fall + winter terms (8 months); the Fall schedule lists both first-year terms (1A/1B or Year 1 rate applies to both). Incidental fees include WUSA health & dental plans, UPass and student services; UHIP (international health insurance) is billed separately and excluded. History from the Fall 2025 and Fall 2024 international schedules.

programmes.name: Master of Applied Science (MASc) in Psychology (Industrial and Organizational Psychology)
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for international students in this 2-year coursework and research-paper master's. Not fixed and may rise; international places are limited. Compulsory fees included; health insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: Fall 2026 international schedule: Graduate Master's Research rate $7,696 per term x 3 terms = $23,088; Psychology has its own full-time incidental fee, $1,024.92 per term x 3 = $3,074.76 ('Programs with different incidental fees' table). Graduate year = 3 terms. UHIP excluded. Programme: MASc in Psychology (Industrial and Organizational Psychology), 24 months full-time, coursework plus a master's research paper (no thesis) with an optional internship; Waterloo lists it as 'Master's, Research' and notes the Faculty of Arts is currently limiting the number of international students it admits (future-graduate-students programme page). The Psychology MA is thesis-only on admission. 2024 = Fall 2024 international master's schedule row 'Psychology - MASc (Industrial and Organizational Psychology)' $7,696 x 3 + incidental $891.19 x 3; 2025 = Fall 2025 schedule research master's $7,696 x 3 + Psychology incidental $948.65 x 3.
